const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const rand = (a,b) => a + Math.random()*(b-a);
const pick = a => a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)];
const song = $('#song'), musicBtn = $('#music');

/* ---------- title ---------- */
(function(){
  const t = $('#title');
  const mk = (txt, cls, off) => {
    const d = document.createElement('span'); d.className = cls;
    [...txt].forEach((c,i)=>{
      const s = document.createElement('span'); s.className='ch';
      s.textContent = c === ' ' ? ' ' : c; s.style.animationDelay = ((i+off)*0.09)+'s'; d.appendChild(s);
    });
    t.appendChild(d); return txt.length;
  };
  const n = mk('Happy Birthday', 'l1', 0);
  mk(NAME + ' 🎂', 'l2', n);
  $('#introTitle').textContent = `Hey ${NAME} 🎉`;
  $('#footName').textContent = NAME;
  document.title = `Happy Birthday ${NAME} 🎂`;
})();

/* ---------- background sparkles ---------- */
(function(){
  const box = $('#sparkles'), em = ['✨','💖','🎈','⭐','🌸','🎀','💫'];
  for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
    const s = document.createElement('span');
    s.textContent = pick(em);
    s.style.left = rand(0,100)+'%';
    s.style.fontSize = rand(16,34)+'px';
    s.style.animationDuration = rand(12,26)+'s';
    s.style.animationDelay = (-rand(0,26))+'s';
    box.appendChild(s);
  }
})();

/* ---------- music ---------- */
let userPaused = false;
song.volume = 0.85;
function setMusicUI(){
  const on = !song.paused;
  musicBtn.textContent = on ? '⏸' : '🎵';
  musicBtn.classList.toggle('playing', on);
}
song.addEventListener('play', setMusicUI);
song.addEventListener('pause', setMusicUI);
function tryPlay(){
  if(userPaused || !song.paused) return Promise.resolve();
  return song.play().catch(()=>{});
}
musicBtn.addEventListener('click', e=>{
  e.stopPropagation();
  if(song.paused){ userPaused=false; song.play().catch(()=>{}); }
  else { userPaused=true; song.pause(); }
});
tryPlay();
['pointerdown','touchstart','keydown','click'].forEach(ev=>{
  window.addEventListener(ev, function first(e){
    if(musicBtn.contains(e.target)) return;
    tryPlay().then(()=>{ if(!song.paused){
      ['pointerdown','touchstart','keydown','click'].forEach(x=>window.removeEventListener(x, first, true));
    }});
  }, true);
});

/* ---------- intro & candle blowout state ---------- */
let candlesLit = true;

$('#openBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  $('#intro').classList.add('hide');
  userPaused=false; song.play().catch(()=>{});
  const r = $('#openBtn').getBoundingClientRect();
  burst(r.left+r.width/2, r.top+r.height/2, 60);
  initAudioCtx();

  // Dim the room for the glowing candles!
  document.body.classList.add('dimmed');
  candlesLit = true;
  box.classList.remove('cut', 'out');
  $('#sub').textContent = 'Make a wish & blow out the candles... ✨🕯️';
  hint.textContent = '💨 Tap the candles to blow them out (make a wish first!) 🕯️';
  hint.classList.remove('done');
});

/* ---------- canvases (HD / 4K sharp) ---------- */
const fw = $('#fw'), cf = $('#cf');
const fctx = fw.getContext('2d'), cctx = cf.getContext('2d');
let W=0,H=0,DPR=1;
function resize(){
  W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 3);
  while(W*H*DPR*DPR > 3840*2160*1.15 && DPR > 1) DPR -= 0.25;
  [fw,cf].forEach(c=>{ c.width = Math.round(W*DPR); c.height = Math.round(H*DPR); });
  fctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0); cctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

/* ---------- fireworks ---------- */
const rockets=[], sparks=[];
let fwOn=false, fwStart=0, nextLaunch=0;
function launch(x){
  const tx = x ?? rand(W*.12, W*.88), ty = rand(H*.12, H*.5);
  const sx = rand(W*.3, W*.7);
  const t = rand(55, 80);
  rockets.push({x:sx,y:H+10,vx:(tx-sx)/t,vy:(ty-(H+10))/t,ty,hue:rand(0,360)});
}
function explode(x,y,hue){
  const k = Math.min(Math.max(Math.min(W,H)/700,.7),1.5);
  const type = pick(['peony','ring','heart','peony','double']);
  const n = type==='heart' ? 110 : rand(110,170);
  const hue2 = (hue+rand(120,200))%360;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    let vx,vy,a=Math.PI*2*i/n, sp;
    if(type==='ring'){ sp=5.2*k; vx=Math.cos(a)*sp; vy=Math.sin(a)*sp; }
    else if(type==='heart'){
      const hx=16*Math.pow(Math.sin(a),3), hy=-(13*Math.cos(a)-5*Math.cos(2*a)-2*Math.cos(3*a)-Math.cos(4*a));
      vx=hx*.34*k; vy=hy*.34*k;
    } else {
      a=rand(0,Math.PI*2); sp=rand(1.2,6.8)*k; vx=Math.cos(a)*sp; vy=Math.sin(a)*sp;
    }
    const h = (type==='double' && i%2) ? hue2 : hue + rand(-14,14);
    sparks.push({x,y,px:x,py:y,vx,vy,life:1,decay:rand(.008,.017),hue:h,size:rand(1.4,2.8)});
  }
  for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
    const a=rand(0,6.28), sp=rand(.3,2.2)*k;
    sparks.push({x,y,px:x,py:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,life:1,decay:rand(.006,.011),hue:50,size:1.6,sat:20,light:90});
  }
}
let last=0;
function frame(t){
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  const dt = Math.min((t-last)/16.667||1, 3); last=t;

  if(fwOn){
    const el = t - fwStart;
    if(t >= nextLaunch){
      if(el < 12000){ const c = Math.random()<.45?2:1; for(let i=0;i<c;i++) launch(); nextLaunch = t + rand(250,520); }
      else { launch(); nextLaunch = t + rand(1300,2400); }
    }
  }

  if(!rockets.length && !sparks.length){ if(fw._dirty){ fctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H); fw._dirty=false; } }
  else {
    fw._dirty = true;
    fctx.globalCompositeOperation='destination-out';
    fctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+Math.min(.22*dt,.6)+')';
    fctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    fctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    fctx.lineCap='round';
    for(let i=rockets.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const r=rockets[i];
      r.x+=r.vx*dt; r.y+=r.vy*dt;
      sparks.push({x:r.x,y:r.y,px:r.x,py:r.y,vx:rand(-.3,.3),vy:rand(.2,.8),life:.7,decay:.035,hue:40,size:1.8,sat:60,light:80});
      fctx.strokeStyle='#fff3c9'; fctx.lineWidth=2.6;
      fctx.beginPath(); fctx.moveTo(r.x-r.vx*2,r.y-r.vy*2); fctx.lineTo(r.x,r.y); fctx.stroke();
      if(r.y<=r.ty){ explode(r.x,r.y,r.hue); rockets.splice(i,1); }
    }
    for(let i=sparks.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      const s=sparks[i];
      s.px=s.x; s.py=s.y;
      s.vx*=Math.pow(.978,dt); s.vy*=Math.pow(.978,dt); s.vy+=.05*dt;
      s.x+=s.vx*dt; s.y+=s.vy*dt; s.life-=s.decay*dt;
      if(s.life<=0){ sparks.splice(i,1); continue; }
      const flick = s.light===90 ? (Math.random()<.5?1:.35) : 1;
      fctx.strokeStyle=`hsla(${s.hue},${s.sat??100}%,${s.light??62}%,${Math.max(s.life,0)*flick})`;
      fctx.lineWidth=s.size*(.5+s.life*.7);
      fctx.beginPath(); fctx.moveTo(s.px,s.py); fctx.lineTo(s.x,s.y); fctx.stroke();
    }
    fctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  }

  cctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  for(let i=confetti.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const c=confetti[i];
    c.vy+=.12*dt; c.vx*=Math.pow(.985,dt); c.vy*=Math.pow(.985,dt);
    c.x+=c.vx*dt; c.y+=c.vy*dt; c.rot+=c.vr*dt; c.life-=c.decay*dt;
    if(c.life<=0 || c.y>H+30){ confetti.splice(i,1); continue; }
    cctx.save(); cctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,c.life*2);
    cctx.translate(c.x,c.y); cctx.rotate(c.rot);
    cctx.scale(1, Math.cos(c.rot*1.7));
    cctx.fillStyle=c.color;
    if(c.shape===0) cctx.fillRect(-c.s/2,-c.s/4,c.s,c.s/2);
    else { cctx.beginPath(); cctx.arc(0,0,c.s/2.4,0,6.283); cctx.fill(); }
    cctx.restore();
  }
}

/* ---------- confetti ---------- */
const confetti=[];
const CONF_COLORS=['#ff5e9c','#ffb347','#ffe14d','#5ee0b5','#59b8ff','#b48cff','#ff8fd8','#ffffff'];
function burst(x,y,n=28,colors=CONF_COLORS){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const a=rand(0,6.283), sp=rand(2,9);
    confetti.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp-3,rot:rand(0,6.28),vr:rand(-.3,.3),
      s:rand(7,13),color:pick(colors),shape:Math.random()<.65?0:1,life:1,decay:rand(.008,.016)});
  }
}
function confettiRain(n=120){
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    confetti.push({x:rand(0,W),y:rand(-H*.3,-10),vx:rand(-1.5,1.5),vy:rand(1,4),rot:rand(0,6.28),vr:rand(-.2,.2),
      s:rand(7,13),color:pick(CONF_COLORS),shape:Math.random()<.65?0:1,life:1.6,decay:rand(.003,.006)});
  }
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{
  if(e.target.closest('button, .balloon, #cakeBox, #knife, #intro')) return;
  burst(e.clientX,e.clientY,16);
});

/* ---------- sound synthesis (pop, blow, chime) ---------- */
let actx=null;
function initAudioCtx(){
  if(!actx){ try{ actx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); }catch(e){} }
  if(actx && actx.state==='suspended') actx.resume();
}
['pointerdown','keydown'].forEach(ev=>window.addEventListener(ev,initAudioCtx,{passive:true}));

function popSound(){
  if(!actx) return;
  const len = actx.sampleRate*.18, buf = actx.createBuffer(1,len,actx.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<len;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/len,3);
  const src=actx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer=buf;
  const f=actx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type='lowpass'; f.frequency.value=1800;
  const g=actx.createGain(); g.gain.value=.55;
  src.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(actx.destination); src.start();
}

function blowSound(){
  if(!actx) return;
  const now = actx.currentTime;
  const dur = 0.58;
  const buf = actx.createBuffer(1, Math.round(actx.sampleRate * dur), actx.sampleRate);
  const data = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.pow(1 - i / data.length, 1.8);
  }
  const noise = actx.createBufferSource();
  noise.buffer = buf;

  const filter = actx.createBiquadFilter();
  filter.type = 'lowpass';
  filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(850, now);
  filter.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(220, now + dur);

  const gain = actx.createGain();
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.48, now + 0.08);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + dur);

  noise.connect(filter);
  filter.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(actx.destination);
  noise.start(now);
  noise.stop(now + dur);

  const notes = [659.25, 783.99, 1046.50];
  notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
    const osc = actx.createOscillator();
    const g = actx.createGain();
    osc.type = 'sine';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + 0.12 + idx * 0.09);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.12 + idx * 0.09);
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.12, now + 0.14 + idx * 0.09);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.8 + idx * 0.09);
    osc.connect(g);
    g.connect(actx.destination);
    osc.start(now + 0.12 + idx * 0.09);
    osc.stop(now + 0.85 + idx * 0.09);
  });
}

/* ---------- balloons ---------- */
const sky=$('#sky');
let balloonTimer=null;
function balloonSVG(c){
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 80 130" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M40 124 q-6 -10 2 -18 q6 -6 -2 -14" stroke="#ffffffaa" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M40 4 C68 4 78 30 74 52 C70 76 52 90 40 92 C28 90 10 76 6 52 C2 30 12 4 40 4Z" fill="${c}"/>
    <path d="M40 92 C28 90 10 76 6 52 C20 78 60 78 74 52 C70 76 52 90 40 92Z" fill="#000" opacity=".1"/>
    <ellipse cx="25" cy="30" rx="8" ry="14" fill="#fff" opacity=".4" transform="rotate(18 25 30)"/>
    <path d="M40 92 l-6 9 h12z" fill="${c}"/><path d="M40 92 l-6 9 h12z" fill="#000" opacity=".15"/>
  </svg>`;
}
function spawnBalloon(){
  if(document.hidden || sky.childElementCount>45) return;
  const c = pick(BALLOON_COLORS), w = rand(54,96);
  const b = document.createElement('div');
  b.className='balloon'; b.dataset.c=c;
  b.style.left = rand(0,100)+'vw';
  b.style.marginLeft = (-w/2)+'px';
  b.style.width = w+'px';
  b.style.animationDuration = rand(8,15)+'s';
  b.innerHTML = balloonSVG(c);
  b.firstChild.style.animationDuration = rand(1.8,3.6)+'s';
  b.addEventListener('animationend', e=>{ if(e.animationName==='rise') b.remove(); });
  sky.appendChild(b);
}
sky.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{
  const b = e.target.closest('.balloon'); if(!b) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();
  burst(r.left+r.width/2, r.top+r.height*.4, 22, [b.dataset.c,'#fff',b.dataset.c]);
  popSound(); b.remove();
});
function startBalloons(){
  if(balloonTimer) return;
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++) setTimeout(spawnBalloon, i*180);
  balloonTimer=setInterval(spawnBalloon, 650);
}
function stopBalloons(){ clearInterval(balloonTimer); balloonTimer=null; sky.innerHTML=''; }

/* ---------- toast ---------- */
let toastT;
function toast(msg){
  const t=$('#toast'); t.textContent=msg; t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastT); toastT=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),3200);
}

/* ---------- blowing out the candles & cutting cake ---------- */
const box=$('#cakeBox'), knife=$('#knife'), hint=$('#hint');
let cut=false, typeT=null;

function blowCandles(e){
  if(!candlesLit || cut) return;
  candlesLit = false;
  initAudioCtx();
  blowSound();
  box.classList.add('out');

  const cr = box.getBoundingClientRect();
  burst(cr.left + cr.width * 0.42, cr.top + cr.height * 0.18, 22, ['#ffe27a','#ffd54a','#fff']);
  burst(cr.left + cr.width * 0.58, cr.top + cr.height * 0.18, 22, ['#ffe27a','#ff9f43','#fff']);

  $('#sub').textContent = '✨ Wish made! Turning on the lights… 💡';
  hint.textContent = '✨ Lights returning… get ready to cut the cake! 🎂';
  toast('✨ Your birthday wish is on its way to the stars! 🌟❤️');

  setTimeout(()=>{
    document.body.classList.remove('dimmed');
    burst(cr.left + cr.width / 2, cr.top + cr.height * 0.35, 45);
    $('#sub').textContent = `Yaaay! Happy Birthday, ${NAME}! 🥳🎉`;
    hint.textContent = '👆 Drag the knife through the cake or tap to cut!';
    knife.classList.remove('gone');
    knife.style.opacity = '1';
    knife.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    knife.style.animation = 'knifeHint 1.8s ease-in-out infinite';
  }, 1150);
}

function doCut(){
  if(cut || candlesLit) return;
  cut=true;
  initAudioCtx();
  popSound();
  box.classList.add('cut','out');
  knife.classList.add('gone');
  $('#sub').textContent = `Happy Birthday ${NAME}! 🥳🍰`;
  hint.textContent='🎉 Pop the balloons! 🎈'; hint.classList.add('done');
  const r=box.getBoundingClientRect();
  burst(r.left+r.width/2, r.top+r.height*.5, 80);
  confettiRain(140);
  setTimeout(()=>$('#sliceWrap').classList.add('show')||$('#slice').classList.add('show'), 500);
  fwOn=true; fwStart=performance.now(); nextLaunch=0;
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++) setTimeout(()=>launch(W*(.12+i*.15)), i*160);
  startBalloons();
  setTimeout(showCard, 2400);
}

function showCard(){
  const card=$('#card'); card.classList.add('show');
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>card.classList.add('in')));
  setTimeout(()=>card.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'}), 700);
  const m=$('#msg'); m.textContent=''; m.classList.remove('done');
  const tapHint=$('#tapHint');
  if(tapHint) tapHint.style.display='block';
  let i=0; clearInterval(typeT);
  const step = 2;
  typeT=setInterval(()=>{
    i = Math.min(i + step, MESSAGE.length);
    m.textContent = MESSAGE.slice(0, i);
    m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
    if(i >= MESSAGE.length){
      clearInterval(typeT);
      typeT=null;
      m.classList.add('done');
      if(tapHint) tapHint.style.display='none';
    }
  }, 22);
}

function finishTypewriter(){
  if(typeT){
    clearInterval(typeT);
    typeT=null;
    const m=$('#msg');
    m.textContent = MESSAGE;
    m.classList.add('done');
    m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
    const tapHint=$('#tapHint');
    if(tapHint) tapHint.style.display='none';
  }
}

$('#card').addEventListener('click', e=>{
  if(e.target.closest('button')) return;
  finishTypewriter();
});

function autoCut(){
  if(cut || candlesLit || knife.classList.contains('drag') || knife.dataset.busy) return;
  knife.dataset.busy='1';
  const k=knife.getBoundingClientRect(), c=box.getBoundingClientRect();
  const dx=(c.left+c.width/2)-(k.left+k.width/2), dy=(c.top+c.height*.62)-(k.top+k.height*.35);
  knife.style.transition='transform .75s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.3,1)';
  knife.style.animation='none';
  knife.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) rotate(0deg)`;
  setTimeout(doCut, 650);
}

box.addEventListener('click', e=>{
  if(e.target.closest('#knife')) return;
  if(candlesLit){
    blowCandles(e);
  } else {
    autoCut();
  }
});

box.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{
  if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(candlesLit) blowCandles(e);
    else autoCut();
  }
});

let sx=0, sy=0;
knife.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{
  if(cut || candlesLit) return;
  e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
  knife.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  knife.classList.add('drag'); knife.style.animation='none'; knife.style.transition='none';
  sx=e.clientX; sy=e.clientY;
});
knife.addEventListener('pointermove', e=>{
  if(!knife.classList.contains('drag') || cut || candlesLit) return;
  const dx=e.clientX-sx, dy=e.clientY-sy;
  knife.style.transform=`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px) rotate(${Math.max(-10,18-dy/8)}deg)`;
  const c=box.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(e.clientX>c.left+c.width*.2 && e.clientX<c.right-c.width*.2 && e.clientY>c.top+c.height*.5 && e.clientY<c.bottom){
    knife.classList.remove('drag'); doCut();
  }
});
const endDrag = e=>{
  if(!knife.classList.contains('drag')) return;
  knife.classList.remove('drag');
  if(!cut){ knife.style.transition=''; knife.style.transform=''; knife.style.animation=''; }
};
knife.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
knife.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);

/* ---------- wish & replay ---------- */
$('#wishBtn').addEventListener('click', e=>{
  const r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  burst(r.left+r.width/2, r.top, 70); confettiRain(90);
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++) setTimeout(()=>launch(), i*200);
  toast('Close your eyes & make a wish… ✨🌟');
});

$('#replayBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  cut=false; fwOn=false; clearInterval(typeT); typeT=null;
  rockets.length=0; sparks.length=0; confetti.length=0; fctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  stopBalloons();
  box.classList.remove('cut','out');
  $('#sliceWrap').classList.remove('show'); $('#slice').classList.remove('show');
  const card=$('#card'); card.classList.remove('in'); setTimeout(()=>card.classList.remove('show'),500);
  delete knife.dataset.busy;
  knife.classList.remove('gone'); knife.style.cssText='';

  // Dim room again & relight candles!
  candlesLit = true;
  document.body.classList.add('dimmed');
  hint.classList.remove('done');
  hint.textContent='💨 Tap the candles to blow them out (make a wish first!) 🕯️';
  $('#sub').textContent='Make a wish & blow out the candles... ✨🕯️';
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
});
</script>
</body>
